Name: Balanced Automate
Author: rsjww
Description:
This is not a mod that requires Automate but a replacement. This mod doesn't auto-collect products.[size=3]

In vanilla gameplay, a machine stops as soon as its finished product isn’t collected.

[b]This mod removes that pause. If materials are available, the machine continues processing naturally. 

[/b]Machines now work and reload when you are sleeping! When paired with Hoppers, this creates a natural, vanilla-feeling form of automation without escalating into industrial gameplay.

[i]Honestly, Hoppers are supposed to be useful, but they’re expensive and often feel kind of underwhelming. This mod gives them a real purpose. If you want automation, you still have to invest resources: The cost of Hoppers keeps everything balanced and prevents things from becoming overpowered.

[/i]UPD: also check [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43279]Mergable Machines[/url], which works especially well with this mod!

[b]This mod is required to be installed by everyone (and same version!) in Multiplayer. 

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/42853/42853-1773206400-1445822497.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]. Android users should also install the [url=https://github.com/NRTnarathip/SMAPILoader/releases]SMAPI Loader[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xEV4WhO.png[/img]

[/b]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], or change in config.json after first-run.
You can configure:
[list]
[*][size=3]Which machine to enable this mod.[/size]
[*]Max Slot: By default, each machine acts like an inventory with 1 slot—you can only stack items of the same type and quality. Increase this value to give the machine more slots, similar to a Chest. Default is 1, which feels most natural. Set this to 0 can disable the mod.
[*]Stack Interval: This sets the timer for repeated stacking. You usually don’t need to adjust it—this lightweight mod rarely causes performance issues on any computer that can run Stardew Valley.
[*]Qi's Help option: will gift you a free Hopper! (only works once for each player).
[/list]
[/size][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png[/img]
